summary: Full **Figures** repertoire & visual position editor (Fase 3): CRUD `/api/v1/figures` + image, transactional `PUT /api/v1/figures/{id}/positions` with optimistic `figure.version` & strict `(-20..20, 0..8)` coordinate bounds, CRUD `/api/v1/position-types` (`technical`/`admin` only), RGPD-filtered `/api/v1/public/figures*` + `/public/position-types`, and web visual grid editor by height level `z`. **Server + web (wasmJs) + Astro public API**.
overview:
Fase 3 repertoire slice covering muixeranga figures, their 3D position placements (`x, y, z`), editable position types, public repertoire endpoints, and the interactive grid editor.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.10, §6.1.1, §6.7 (figuras), §6.8 (`/public/figures*`, `/public/position-types`), §7.4 (Figures), §12.2 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-schema-v02` (`figures` with `name UNIQUE`, `positions` with `UNIQUE(figure_id, x, y, z)`, `UNIQUE(figure_id, user_id)`, and `CHECK(x BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND y BETWEEN -20 AND 20 AND z BETWEEN 0 AND 8)`, `position_types` with 10 seeded types).
- `platform-core-contract` (`Figure*`, `Position*`, `PutFigurePositionsRequest(version, positions)`, `PositionType*`, `FigureValidator`).
- `platform-server-auth`, `platform-files` (figure image upload), `spec-05-members` (member lookup for position assignment), `platform-web-shell`, `platform-openapi-deploy`.

**Key business, permission & RGPD rules (`decisiones.md` & §5.10)**
- **Split write permissions (§4.4 / §6.1.1):**
  - `figures` and `positions`: read by `member`+ (and public); write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /figures*`, `PUT /figures/{id}/positions`, image) by **`technical`, `board`, `admin`**.
  - `position-types`: read by `member`+ (and public); write (`POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /position-types*`) by **`technical` and `admin` ONLY** (`board` receives `403`!). Deleting a `PositionType` still referenced by any `Position` returns `409 in_use` (`ON DELETE RESTRICT`).
- **Transactional `PUT /api/v1/figures/{id}/positions` (`decisiones.md`):** body `PutFigurePositionsRequest(version: Int, positions: List<PositionInput>)`. Checks `figures.version == request.version` (`409 version_conflict` with current figure + positions if stale), validates all positions in one pass (`x,y ∈ -20..20`, `z ∈ 0..8`, no duplicate `(x,y,z)` → `409 duplicate` / `422`, no duplicate non-null `userId` in the same figure → `409 duplicate` / `422`, every `positionTypeId` exists, every non-null `userId` exists and is not `deleted`), atomically replaces all `positions` for `figureId` (preserving client-supplied `id` if already owned by the figure or generating UUIDv7), and increments `figures.version`.
- **Public API filtering (§5.10, §6.8):**
  - `GET /api/v1/public/figures` and `/public/figures/{id}` (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`): exclude `status = retired` (`404` on `/public/figures/{id}` if retired), omit `videoUrl` (visibility `members`), and map `Position.userId = null` whenever the assigned person is a minor, non-`active`, or has `consent.publicProfile == false`.
  - `GET /api/v1/public/position-types`: returns all position types with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- Permission matrix test explicitly confirms `board` can edit figures/positions (`200`/`201`) but gets **`403`** on `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE /position-types*`, whereas `technical` and `admin` succeed.
- `PUT /figures/{id}/positions` rejects stale `version` (`409 version_conflict`), out-of-range coords (`422`), duplicate `(x,y,z)`, and duplicate `userId` without partial writes (transactional rollback).
- `GET /api/v1/public/figures` omits `retired` figures, omits `videoUrl`, and sets `userId = null` for minors and non-public members.
- Web UI at `/figures` renders figure list + detail + visual grid editor by level `z` (`0..8`) with drag/click placement, person duplicate warning, `position-types` management modal (visible only with `position-types:write`), and `409` reload handling.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes.
shared_ui_policy: All figures UI, grid editor, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Per-event lineups (`Lineup`) and AI rehearsal planner (§11 future phase).
- Attendance (`spec-07-attendance`).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. Figures tab needs `figures:read`; figure & position editing needs `figures:write`; position-types management needs `position-types:write` (`technical`/`admin` only).
auth.server: Private read: `member`+. Write figures/positions: `technical`, `board`, `admin`. Write position-types: `technical`, `admin` ONLY (`403` for `board` and `member`). Public routes: anonymous.

components.name: Figures.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for `figures`, `positions` (joined with `users` + `position_types` for RGPD filtering), `position_types`, usage count for `409 in_use`, and version-checked figure updates.

components.name: FigureService + PositionTypeService
components.usage: CRUD figures (unique name `409 duplicate`, image upload/delete via `FileStorageService`), transactional `replacePositions(figureId, version, positions)` validating bounds `-20..20`/`0..8`, unique `(x,y,z)`, unique `userId`, and existing refs; CRUD position-types with `409 in_use` on delete.

components.name: FigureMapper
components.usage: Maps `Figure` (`members` audience incl. `videoUrl` + all assigned `userId`) and `FigurePublic` (omits `videoUrl`, nulls `userId` for minors/inactive/non-public members).

components.name: FigureRoutes
components.usage: Mounts all 15 private + public routes for figures, positions, and position-types with split role guards.

components.name: MuixerangaApi (figures extension)
components.usage: Client methods for figures CRUD, image upload/delete, `getFigurePositions`, `putFigurePositions(id, PutFigurePositionsRequest)`, and position-types CRUD.

components.name: FiguresRepository + FiguresViewModel + FigureEditorViewModel
components.usage: Manages figure list/filters, position-types CRUD, local draft grid state per level `z` (`0..8`) with duplicate-person detection before save, `PUT /figures/{id}/positions` with `version`, and `409` reload recovery.

components.name: FiguresScreen + FigureEditorScreen + PositionTypesDialog
components.usage: Routes `/figures` and `/figures/{id}`: `KpiFilterStrip`, figure cards with `status` & `levels`, interactive level selector (`z = 0..8`) + scrollable grid (`x,y ∈ -20..20`) supporting both drag-and-drop (desktop) and tap-to-place (mobile/touch), inspector panel to pick `positionType` and member (warning if member already placed in this figure), and `PositionTypesDialog` gated by `position-types:write`.

structure:
Vertical slice flow:

```text
Web /figures & /figures/{id}
  → FiguresViewModel / FigureEditorViewModel → FiguresRepository → MuixerangaApi
  ↕ JSON + Multipart (Bearer)
Server FigureRoutes → FigureService / PositionTypeService (+ FileStorageService) → FigureMapper → Figures.sq
  ↑
Astro public site → GET /api/v1/public/figures, /public/figures/{id}, /public/position-types
```

sections.title: Transactional positions replace & optimistic locking (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: `PUT /api/v1/figures/{id}/positions` receives `{version, positions: [{id?, positionTypeId, userId?, x, y, z}]}`.
sections.behavior: Inside `DatabaseAccess.writeTransaction`: check `figures.version == request.version` (`409 version_conflict` with current figure if mismatch); validate every position (`x,y ∈ -20..20`, `z ∈ 0..8`, unique `(x,y,z)`, unique non-null `userId`, existing `positionTypeId` and active/non-deleted `userId`); delete old rows and insert new set; increment `figures.version`; return updated positions + new `version`.

sections.title: Visual grid editor UX (§7.4)
sections.description: Editor displays level tabs `Piso z` (`0 = Pinya/terra`, `1..levels`), a zoomable/pannable grid centered on `(0,0)` with coordinates `x,y ∈ -20..20`, and a side/bottom inspector.
sections.behavior: Supports both drag-and-drop and click/tap-to-place so it stays usable on mobile touch screens (≥360 px). Selecting a member who is already assigned to another cell in the same figure displays a clear Valencian warning and offers to move them from the previous cell.

endpoints.name: Upload / delete figure image
endpoints.notes: Also `DELETE /api/v1/figures/{id}/image`. `technical`/`board`/`admin`. Max 10 MB; upload rate limit.

endpoints.name: Replace figure positions
endpoints.notes: `technical`/`board`/`admin`. Body `{version, positions}`. Transactional; validates bounds `-20..20`/`0..8`, unique `(x,y,z)`, unique `userId`, optimistic `version`.

endpoints.name: Delete position type
endpoints.notes: `technical`/`admin` ONLY. `204`, or `409 in_use` if referenced by any position.

endpoints.name: Public figures list
endpoints.notes: Anonymous, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Non-retired only; no `videoUrl`; `userId = null` for non-public/minors.

persistence: Uses SQLite v0.2 `figures`, `positions`, `position_types`, `users`, and `stored_files` via `Figures.sq`. No new migrations.
